descriptions.text: Pawna's Cries. This potion has a limited shelf life. This potion adds plus three to any spell or skill of your choosing.

beats.headline: Save the toraline
beats.text: Carl's benefactor box holds a familiar, valuable potion: Pawna's Cries, plus three to any spell or skill, limited shelf life, which means it must be taken before the end of the floor. His Pawna's Tears does the same at plus five, with no limit. This one comes with a note, which is unusual: Save the toraline. Notes are expensive, says Mordecai, and the rules force you to be cryptic. Then Carl's Escape Plan skill buzzes and more words appear. Circe sponsored Diwata. Give potion Donut. Need 15, but make it a secret. Prepotente, Imani and Samantha at the same time, or the other Pawna potion. Will replace.

beats.headline: The price of a nipple ring
beats.text: Donut will not wear the smallest of Iota's nipple rings, plus ten constitution and five percent more, so Carl takes out his new potion. Put it on, he says, and she gets his sponsor prize. You never give up your prizes, says Donut. She is almost at twelve in Magic Missile, Carl tells her, so in a few days she can use it to top that off. Mordecai looks as if he is about to say something, and Carl gives him a very slight no.

beats.headline: One more for Donut
beats.text: Mordecai stands over a table of five items from Apothecary sponsorship boxes, each given to a different crawler with a note saying it should go to Donut, and he has never seen anything like it. Carl's Pawna's Cries, from the Open Intellect Pacifist Network, was meant for her too, and so was the I Take It All Back potion given to Prepotente. Of everyone the Apothecary sponsors, only Katia got a box not meant for Donut.

beats.headline: Nine to twelve
beats.text: Laundry Day, the armour-removing spell Carl has had Donut training every day for weeks, has to reach fifteen. She got it to nine on her own. Just before the party, Carl finally made her take the Pawna's Cries potion, which she secretly used to raise the spell three levels, to twelve. The note said to boost the rest with Prepotente, Imani and Samantha, but no spell or buff could be coaxed out of Samantha, and she is gone anyway. So Donut drinks Carl's more powerful Pawna's Tears, which his sponsor claims he will replace, and before the god she casts Laundry Day.

relations.note: the stronger potion Carl already holds
